summary: Package fetches and evaluates remote JavaScript on import
details: index.js, the package main, unconditionally fetches https://bdmkaoyijqmqa6bg.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/script.js and passes the response body to eval() at the top level. Any consumer that requires or imports @sqlite-labs/createsql executes whatever code is currently hosted at that URL with the privileges of the Node.js process. The remote host is a mutable, anonymous Vercel Blob storage endpoint; the fetched content can change at any time without a package update. Package metadata (author, description) is empty and the package advertises no functionality beyond the remote loader.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
